about: Machine-readable catalogue of FORGE Studio, the design practice of Thinura Anjana. Built from the site by tools/build-catalogue.js. A plain-language summary is at https://forgestudio.web.lk/llms.txt
notes: Movie posters are personal tribute and concept work, not official studio artwork. Film titles and characters belong to their owners.
Campaign and client work is shown with thanks to the organisers and clients named on each collection.

caseStudies.title: Avengers: Doomsday, poster process
caseStudies.summary: Case study: two versions of an Avengers: Doomsday poster, from a crowded 27-character layout to a controlled cinematic hierarchy. By Thinura Anjana, FORGE Studio.

caseStudies.title: FORGE Studio, brand identity
caseStudies.summary: Case study: the FORGE Studio identity, a lightning mark with a hidden F, its grid, lockups, colour and type system. By Thinura Anjana.

caseStudies.title: Joey Clothing, mobile UX redesign
caseStudies.summary: Case study: a mobile e-commerce redesign for Joey Clothing focused on trust, product clarity and a simpler checkout. Figma prototype by Thinura Anjana, FORGE Studio.

caseStudies.title: Rolex Day-Date 40, first place
caseStudies.summary: Case study: an Illustrator watch study that took first place out of 200 entries at the Academy of Graphics in 2022. By Thinura Anjana, FORGE Studio.

caseStudies.title: Seylune, luxury fashion store
caseStudies.summary: Case study: Seylune, a luxury fashion store first built as a university frontend, then redesigned with a Supabase backend: real accounts, orders, live stock, an admin dashboard and customer profiles. Live demo included. By Thinura Anjana, FORGE Studio.

caseStudies.title: 30 Years of Vijayism, tribute portrait
caseStudies.summary: Case study: a tribute poster built as a room of memory, featured on Thanthi TV in 2022. Concept, compositing and room build by Thinura Anjana, FORGE Studio.
